status: inventory and export rules for root verification; no value here is frozen by the author
rule: E05 (m1-draft-0.2/M1-UNRESOLVED-0.2.md): every hash-bearing fixture is re-checked with three Keccak libraries before it is frozen. A placeholder, an unapproved parameter, an unavailable compiler output or an absent preimage is an explicit blocker, never a frozen value.

entryFields: source (fixture file and JSON path, or saved check)
export.order: sorted by id; no timestamp; compact one entry per line, so the file is byte-reproducible
export.excluded: keys, private-source messages, dependencies and binaries are never exported

triad.rootInventory: coordination/review-001/e05-historical-evidence-inventory.json (recorded SHA-256 of the inputs and of the three result files)
triad.binding: run_checks_025 rebuilds every one of the 611 preimages from the CURRENT fixtures by the generator's rules and requires byte equality with the TSV, the TSV and result SHA-256 values to equal root's inventory, and every fixture-asserted digest to equal the TSV digest.

e05.binding: GSV1 is rebuilt from m1-draft-0.21/vectors/v3-gsv1.json flatSegments and must hash (SHA-256) to the recorded inputSha256

classes.triad: preimage in the 611-row triad; verified by three libraries; binding re-checked now
classes.e05: K1-K3 and GSV1, verified by three libraries in the 0.22 E05 evidence
classes.pendingRootTriad: preimage literal or derivable from current fixtures, never checked by three libraries; exported for root
classes.synthetic: author- or source-chosen opaque value, not a computed hash; no preimage exists or is required
classes.privateProvenance: SHA-256 of a private source message; the preimage stays with root and is not exported
classes.fileSha256: SHA-256 of a public package file; recomputed by the runner
classes.keyDerived: an address derived from a fixture private key; excluded (no key material is exported)
classes.placeholder: a digest of a preimage that contains source-absent placeholders; computed at run time only and never frozen
classes.derivedArithmetic: a value obtained from a hashed value by integer arithmetic (base + 1, base + 2, base + i)

parameters.U01: owner: full factory address (0x0000000000000000000000000000000000c0c005 is the 0.2 proposal); enters every CREATE2 preimage, every chunk address and every manifest that lists chunk addresses
parameters.P-ABI: reviewer: proposed function, error and event signatures (m1-draft-0.2 section 5.3; U22); not compiler output
parameters.E04: experiment: compiler ABI and storageLayout, unavailable until implementation
parameters.P-X1: reviewer: integer encoding of chainId in the netKey RLP (R3-07 label P)
parameters.TK-1: reviewer: fixture-key derivation and the txA fee and gas fields (m1-draft-0.5 annex/br-messages.json label)
parameters.ALT-E: snapshot alternative E (m1-draft-0.7) was evaluated, not adopted
